availability_probe.note: 3-token prompt succeeded on the first attempt

results.error: 503 UNAVAILABLE — 'This model is currently experiencing high demand.'

results.reason: pipeline aborted when the enriched input exhausted its retry budget; no request for this input was ever issued

diagnosis.reasoning: 503 is temporary provider unavailability. It is NOT 401/403 (the key authenticated and calls succeeded), NOT 404 (the model resolved and returned a normal completion), and NOT 429 (no quota or rate-limit response was returned).
diagnosis.permitted_observation: One larger synthetic request failed with 503 after a 5-token probe and a 5,543-token human transcript had both succeeded.
diagnosis.explicitly_not_claimed: No association with request length is claimed. n=1 failed request cannot establish one, and the second synthetic input was never attempted, so there is no second observation to reason from.

note: Stopped after the built-in retry budget. No additional probing.

factual_correction.what_was_wrong: An earlier version of this record and of PRE_EVALUATION_GATE_REPORT.md stated or implied that BOTH synthetic windows returned 503, and drew an inference from two synthetic failures. That is factually wrong.
factual_correction.what_actually_happened: Exactly ONE synthetic input was attempted: enriched FG1 replication 2. It failed with 503 after the built-in 6 retries. Demographics-only FG1 replication 2 was NEVER attempted — the pipeline aborted when the enriched input exhausted its retry budget.
factual_correction.evidence: The run output contains exactly one 'computed' line (human_fg1) and exactly 6 '[transient]' lines, i.e. one input's retry budget. There is no output line for either synthetic run, and no cache entry or error record exists for demographics-only.
factual_correction.inference_withdrawn: The claim that failures were size-correlated rested on 'the two ~8,000-word synthetic windows did not succeed'. Only one was attempted, so that reasoning is withdrawn entirely.
factual_correction.call_logs_untouched: analysis/coding_frame/gemini_calls.jsonl and preflight_availability_probe.jsonl are historical records and were NOT edited. Only this report-level record was corrected.
